_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Funds Status Report
summary: The Funds Status Report gives the government visibility into contractor direct and indirect expenditures, depicting the monthly budget and expenditures for the CTTR at different financial levels for the base or option year.
use_relationship:
The Funds Status Report (FSR) provides the government visibility into contractor direct and indirect expenditures under the contract. It depicts the monthly budget and expenditures for the Combined Tactical Training Ranges (CTTR) and different financial levels for the base or option year.
This data item description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Funds Status Report (FSR) shall be in a format similar to that of Figure 2 (Sample Worksheet).

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The FSR shall contain a workbook with multiple worksheets that depict the monthly budget and expenditures for the CTTR and different financial levels for the base or option year. It shall include a worksheet for each location and element identified by a box in Figure 1, CTTR Financial Organization Worksheet Chart. Each Worksheet shall contain all the information in Figure 2 and shall also include the following:

children.title: Task Order number and applicable modification number associated with the data provided.
Date
children.content: Identify the applicable reporting period date.

children.title: ODCs with associated totals for the appropriate contracting year.
Actual costs vice forecasted costs shall be identified for the reporting month. Different colors shall specify the distinction between forecast and actual costs.
Any updates to past month's actual costs shall be shown.
Costs shall be graphically shown without Fee for the Forecast Total and Funding Received Total.
Information or cost data that is not required shall be identified by shaded cells as specified in Figure 2.
An explanation for expenditure variance 20% or greater shall be included.
A summary of any costs savings and avoidances that contain the following:
Any applicable procedure or Work Instruction changes
The FSR shall also contain totals that equal the Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) Report totals for the reporting month.

preparation_instructions.title: Media Requirements.
preparation_instructions.content: The Funds Status Report shall be a workbook in Microsoft Excel 2007.
